title: Jenkins dingding-notifications Cleartext Storage of Credentials Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Jenkins. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the dingding-notifications plugin. The issue results from storing credentials in plaintext. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the build process.
